• About Our Brand: Founded by Tom Walsh, Stealth Health Containers offers eco-smart, reusable meal prep containers designed for health-conscious, sustainable living. Built for durability and convenience, these products are scaling rapidly across the Stealth Health Life community.

  • What Makes Us Different: Backed by Tom’s established Stealth Health Life audience of engaged, health-focused followers already seeking sustainable meal prep solutions.

  • How Affiliates Earn: Earn 5% commission on every sale, ($100 AOV) plus recurring monthly income from subscriptions and large bonuses on wholesale orders.

  • Other Information: Fast payouts, transparent tracking, and long-term earning potential through a rapidly growing, high-demand product line.

Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

This document outlines the terms and conditions governing participation in the Stealth Health Containers ("Company") Affiliate Program, managed by Nativz ("Agency"). By enrolling in or participating in the Program, you ("Creator") agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, you are not authorized to participate.

1. Program Participation

1.1. Agreement to Promote: The Creator agrees to promote the Company's products to their audience using a unique affiliate code and/or a unique tracking link provided by the Agency. In exchange, the Agency will provide commissions for sales generated through that code or link, and the Company will provide sample products as outlined below.

1.2. Creator Responsibilities: The Creator agrees to:

  • Use the unique affiliate code and/or tracking link in all relevant promotional content.

  • Utilize the provided sample products to create promotional content.

  • Maintain active participation by promoting the affiliate code or tracking link at least once per month.

  • Ensure all promotions and endorsements are authentic, truthful, and comply with all applicable FTC guidelines regarding disclosures.

1.3. Agency & Company Responsibilities: The Agency and Company agree to:

  • Provide a unique affiliate code and/or tracking link for the Creator to track sales.

  • Ship the designated sample product package to the Creator's valid shipping address upon execution of this agreement.

  • Accurately track sales and facilitate commission payouts.

2. Commissions & Payments

2.1. Commission Rate: The Creator will earn a 4% commission on the net sales price of each completed sale made using their unique affiliate code or tracking link.

2.2. Payouts: Commissions will be paid by the Agency on the 1st of each month via the UpPromote platform.

2.3. Minimum Threshold: A minimum accumulated balance of $50.00 USD is required for a payout to be processed. Balances below this threshold will carry over to the next month.

2.4. Exclusions: Commissions will not be paid on sales that are refunded, canceled, or charged back.

3. Content Ownership & License

The Creator retains full ownership of all content they create for this partnership. By participating in the Program, the Creator grants the Company and the Agency a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, and perpetual license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, and display the created content on their respective social media channels, websites, and marketing materials, with full credit and attribution given to the Creator.

4. Term & Termination

This agreement is effective immediately upon your enrollment in the Program and will continue on a month-to-month basis. Any party may terminate this agreement at any time, for any reason, with 30 days' written notice. Upon termination, a final commission payout for any outstanding balance will be made on the next scheduled payout date, provided the minimum threshold is met.

5. Independent Contractor Status

The Creator is an independent contractor. Nothing in this agreement shall be construed as creating an employment, partnership, or joint venture relationship between the Creator and the Agency or the Company. The Creator is solely responsible for any and all taxes, including self-employment taxes, on the compensation received.

6. General Provisions

6.1. Modification of Terms: The Agency reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of any significant changes via the email address associated with your account. Your continued participation in the Program after such modifications constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

6.2. Limitation of Liability: To the fullest extent permitted by law, neither the Agency nor the Company shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with your participation in the Program.

6.3. Governing Law: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the state of Nativz's or Stealth Health Containers' jurisdiction, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

6.4. Entire Agreement: This document constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements, negotiations, and understandings, both oral and written.
